name: Shanta Devi Temple, Shringinari
summary: Shringinari — living temple of Mata Shanta, remembered in regional Ramayana as Dasharatha’s daughter and Rama’s sister.
famousFor: Temple of Rama’s elder sister Shanta · Angadesh memory
mythology: Many North Indian tellings say Dasharatha and Kausalya’s daughter Shanta was given in adoption to King Romapada of Anga. She married sage Rishyasringa, whose putrakameshti yajna opened the way for Rama’s birth. At Shringinari near Basti, devotees honour Mata Shanta as the forgotten elder sister whose story still stands in stone.
